items.title: George Guesnon Interview, 1965-09
items.q: The next block over is a place called Lafitte Street. Lafitte.

ctx.x: Oh no man, this is when I got married. That's all it is. That's how I knew all it was. Fast, quick. No standard decisions. Let's get it done now, you know. In everything, you know. Yeah, yeah. See right there on four blocks when you get to Aureen Street. Mm-hmm. The next block over is a place called Lafitte Street. Lafitte.
